description: This file provides secure environment variable handling for a React frontend, including validation, access helpers, and environment snapshot caching.

methods.name: requireEnv
methods.description: Returns an environment variable value; throws an error if missing or empty.

methods.name: optionalEnv
methods.description: Returns an environment variable value or a fallback if missing or empty.

methods.name: getEnv
methods.description: Returns a frozen snapshot of relevant environment variables with defaults and validation.
